story.summaryEn:
Post-race penalties to both cars means we're leaving Mexico City with no points.
A disappointing way to end the weekend after a positive race from both Pierre and Franco.
detailZh:
赛后对两辆车的处罚意味着我们带着没有积分离开墨西哥城。
在皮埃尔和弗朗哥都表现出色的比赛中，这是一个令人失望的周末结束方式。
detailEn:
Post-race penalties to both cars means we're leaving Mexico City with no points.
A disappointing way to end the weekend after a positive race from both Pierre and Franco.
